title: When the Contact Falls
author: Lena Okonkwo
blurb: Sable Marchetti, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
